name: Disable Cimom Events
description: Prevents background logging of system and hardware events, reducing unnecessary telemetry and CPU usage.
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Wbem\CIMOM" /v EnableEvents /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Wbem\CIMOM" /v Logging /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\WBEM\CIMOM" /v EnableEvents /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\WBEM\CIMOM" /v Logging /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
revert22H2:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Wbem\CIMOM" /v EnableEvents /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Wbem\CIMOM" /v Logging /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\WBEM\CIMOM" /v EnableEvents /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\WBEM\CIMOM" /v Logging /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
